purpose: Current public/external data acquisition recheck for MouldMaster. This record distinguishes newly resolved authoritative context from payloads or channel semantics that remain unavailable. Metadata, sensor-family capability, publication-reported counts and inaccessible payloads do not increase accepted measured-data counts.

newlyResolvedContext: The lower-workpiece delivered TXT format explicitly declares pressure in bar, melt volume in cm3 and injection flow in cm3/s.
The upper-workpiece public files expose time, injection_pressure_target, injection_pressure_actual, melt_volume, injection_velocity and state.
